name: Nice Price Editor – Bulk Table Price Editor for WooCommerce
author: taraskinsdev

sections.description:
Nice Price Editor is a lightweight bulk price editor for WooCommerce that allows store administrators to quickly update product and variation prices in one convenient table view.

Unlike the default WooCommerce editor, Nice Price Editor provides a spreadsheet-like table interface that makes bulk price management simple and efficient. Stop opening each product manually one by one just to change a price.

With Nice Price Editor, you can:

✔ Edit simple and variable product prices in one screen
✔ Update variation prices without opening the product page
✔ Filter products by category
✔ Save changes instantly using AJAX (no page reloads)
✔ Work in a clean, distraction-free interface

Perfect for stores with large catalogs or frequent price updates.

Requires WooCommerce 6.0+.

Usage

  1. Open “Nice Price Editor” in the WordPress admin.
  2. Select a product category if needed.
  3. Enter a new price and click “Save”.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the nice-price-editor folder to wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin in the WordPress admin.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is active.
sections.faq:
Does it support variable products?

Yes. You can edit variation prices directly from the table interface.

Does it reload the page after saving?

No. Prices are updated instantly using AJAX.

Is it compatible with the latest WooCommerce version?

The plugin is tested with WooCommerce 6.0+ and the latest WordPress releases.
